title: Step 64-F account Wishlist, in-app notifications and contract-authorized customer tools
description: MEDIUM-risk Step 64-F. Productionize SF-E-06 /account/tools with only runtime-proven customer capabilities: Wishlist management and customer in-app notifications. Reuse Step-62 Wishlist authority and Stage-64-B notification bridge. Product Alerts, Loyalty and Reviews remain NO_ACTION because Stage 64-B proved no matching customer runtime controller. Do not invent endpoints, backend rules, browser authority, provider delivery behavior or Step 64-G+ functionality.

dependencies.evidence: PR #324 merged; exact merge-SHA Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality and CodeQL all succeeded; application regression 970/970 PASS; terminal Lock release comment 6017547738.

acceptance_criteria.description: SF-E-06 /account/tools is productionized from the authenticated customer session and no longer uses RoutePlaceholder.

Wishlist list is loaded only from canonical GET /customer/wishlist; account management supports removal using canonical DELETE /customer/wishlist/{product_id} with required Idempotency-Key. Addition remains available on existing Product/Listing surfaces and is not duplicated with invented product lookup authority.

Customer in-app notifications use only GET /customer/notifications, PATCH /customer/notifications/{id}/read and POST /customer/notifications/{id}/acknowledge. Mutations use required idempotency and owner-scoped identifiers.
Notification payload objects are never rendered raw or treated as navigation/action authority; only typed title/body/state/timestamps are presented.

Wishlist and notification resources recover independently with partial failure states; 401 fails closed to unauthenticated presentation and ownership-denied mutation states reveal no other-customer existence/content.

Product Alerts, Loyalty and Reviews remain explicitly NO_ACTION in Step 64 because Stage 64-B did not prove customer-facing runtime controllers. No calls to their OpenAPI-only declarations are introduced.
Customer session cookies stay server-only through CustomerSessionBridge; no session/token/secret/browser-local authority is introduced.

Persian RTL UI provides semantic tool navigation, empty/partial/error/status states, 44px targets, visible focus, bidi-isolated identifiers and responsive 320px/400% reflow without brown palette additions.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-merge-SHA verification and terminal Lock release. Human Gate is not required for MEDIUM Stage 64-F.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 64-F is MEDIUM risk and requires no Project Owner Human Gate. Exact artifact must still pass deterministic Review/verification and remain inside frozen Storefront-only scope.
